QuestInfo.name: The Hero of MapleStory!
QuestInfo.0: They say that an incredible gift is being prepared to coincide with the strengthening of MapleStory's Explorer skills.
QuestInfo.1: Reach Lv. 10 with an Explorer character.
QuestInfo.2: You achieved Lv. 10 and received a beginner weapon.

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k! Congratulations on choosing an Explorer class! Have you heard that MapleStory is conducting an extensive improvement of the Explorer class skills? You can find more information on our homepage! In any case, I am here on an important mission to hand out some incredible gifts to Explorers as a way of celebrating this occasion.
0.1: This event has been prepared to thank the many Explorers who have loved and supported MapleStory. The event is quite simple. Each time you increase 10 levels, you'll be receiving a fabulous prize. Increase 10 levels the first time, and I'll give you a weapon that will greatly benefit you in your future development. Would you like to participate?

yes.0: Great! Just be sure to see me once you reach Lv. 10!

no.0: A great opportunity like this will be hard to come by again. Why don't you think about it some more? Come back to me if you change your mind.

1.0: Have you reached Lv. 10? Then choose one of the items below. You only get one chance, so it's wise to pick an item that you really need.

yes.0: Awesome! You know that beginning from Lv. 10, all characters can make a job advancement, right? With the weapon I just gave you, I'm sure you'll be able to reach Lv. 20 in the blink of an eye!

default.0: Hmm... It doesn't look like you've reached Lv. 10 yet. It's real easy. Just reach Lv. 10, then return to see me.

item.0: Hmm... It looks like you already have one of the Explorer Rings. Unfortunately, you won't be able to participate in this event.
